app.name: Usland
app.tagline: Every moment you share leaves a trace on a little world that belongs only to you two.

welcome.title: Welcome to Usland
welcome.intro: A tiny island just for the two of you. Send gentle whispers, take on date quests, meet each other's forest animals, and keep every shared moment here.
welcome.illustration_alt: A cute island surrounded by the sea

form.nickname_placeholder: Your partner will see this name
form.pin_hint: You'll use it to log in, so remember it

create.title: Create your island
create.intro: Give your island a name, then send the invite code to your partner.
create.have_code: Have an invite code? Join an island

invite.title: Your island is ready!
invite.intro: Send this invite code to your partner
invite.copy_failed: Couldn't copy. Please note the code down.
invite.how: They open the same web address, tap “Join with an invite code” on the login page and enter this code.

join.title: Join an island
join.intro: Enter the invite code your partner sent you and move in together.
join.full_text: This island already has two residents. If you're one of them, please log in.

login.title: Back to {island}
login.join_link: Not a resident yet? Join with an invite code

waiting.title: You can play together once your partner joins
waiting.text: Send them the invite code below. This page updates by itself when they arrive.

errors.nickname: Please enter a nickname (up to 20 characters)

errors.choose_member: Please choose who you are first

errors.confirm_rebuild: Please tick the box to confirm first.

map.load_failed: The island picture didn't load. You can still tap the name signs to go anywhere.

feature.soon_text: This spot is still being built. Check back soon!

regions_desc.whisper_pier: For the words that are hard to say, let the island deliver them gently.
regions_desc.quest_board: Each of you picks a few things, and the board finds a date quest that suits you both.
regions_desc.first_meet_forest: Take the forest animal personality quiz and meet each other's animals.
regions_desc.memory_cottage: Keep all the days you've shared safe in this little cottage.
regions_desc.mailbox: Island settings live here: names, language and the whisper magic key.

panel.quest_step1: Each of you picks: time, budget, mood and what you want
panel.quest_step2: The board finds the 3 quests that suit you best
panel.quest_step3: Choose one together, do it, and keep a photo

whisper.title: Whispers
whisper.reconcile_waiting: You've reached out. Waiting for your partner.
whisper.reconcile_partner: Your partner wants to make up
whisper.tip1: Sharing how you feel and what you hope for is easier to hear than pointing out what's wrong.
whisper.tip2: Gentle delivery rewords your message. Only you can see the original.
whisper.tip3: For everyday chat, just use “Send as is”.
whisper.placeholder: What would you like to tell them?
whisper.empty: No whispers yet. Write the first thing you'd like to say.
whisper.softening: The island is finding gentle words…
whisper.preview_title: Here's a gentler way to say it
whisper.your_original: Your original (only you can see this)
whisper.not_counseling: Usland is not a counselling service
whisper.need_key_title: Light up the whisper magic first
whisper.need_key_text: Whispers need a DeepSeek API key. Enter it once and you can both use it.

key.title: Light up the whisper magic
key.intro: Whispers need a DeepSeek API key. Each island only needs one, shared by you both.
key.tutorial_title: How do I get an API key? (4 steps)
key.step1: Open the DeepSeek platform (platform.deepseek.com), then sign up and log in.
key.step2: Top up a small balance on the billing page. A few dollars lasts a long time.
key.step3: Create a new key on the “API keys” page.
key.step4: Copy the key (it starts with sk-) and paste it below.
key.label: DeepSeek API key
key.format: That doesn't look like an API key. Please check and paste it again.
key.privacy: The key is stored only on your own island instance and used only for whispers. Messages are sent to DeepSeek to be reworded.

errors.invalid_key: That API key isn't right. Please check and paste it again.
errors.no_balance: Your DeepSeek balance has run out. Please top up first.
errors.network: The connection is a bit shaky. Please try again soon.
errors.rate_limited: Too many requests. Please wait a moment and try again.
errors.error: The magic isn't working right now. Please try again later.
errors.limit: Today's magic is used up. Come back tomorrow!
errors.key_invalid_now: The whisper magic key seems to have stopped working. Please enter it again.

safety.title: Let's pause for a moment
safety.text: Something in this message sounds worrying. If you or your partner are in danger, please reach out for help.

quest.title: Date Quests
quest.waiting_title: The board is waiting for {name}'s picks…
quest.waiting_text: Recommended quests will appear here once {name} has chosen. Until then, both of your picks stay secret.
quest.deciding_hint_none: Pick one you'd like to do and tap “Choose this” to suggest it.
quest.deciding_hint_mine: You suggested “{title}”. Waiting for your partner to agree. You can still pick another.
quest.deciding_hint_partner: {name} suggested “{title}”. Tap “Agree” to lock it in, or suggest another one.
quest.confirmed_text: When you're done, tap “We did it!” to keep a line about it, and a photo if you like.
quest.note_label: One line to remember it by (required)
quest.note_placeholder: e.g. I never knew your favourite cartoon was…
quest.photo_label: Photo (optional: jpg / png / webp, up to 5MB)
quest.celebrate_text: This moment is now in the Memory Cottage.
quest.cancel_confirm: End this round? All picks and suggestions will be cleared.
quest.cancelled: Round ended. Start a new quest any time.

errors.stale: Things just changed, so the page has been updated. Please take another look.
errors.bad_task: That quest isn't one of the picks.
errors.note_required: Please write a line about it.

errors.bad_type: Only jpg, png or webp photos are supported.
errors.broken: That photo couldn't be opened. Please try another.

forest.title: First Meet Forest
forest.subtitle: Forest Animal Personality Quiz
forest.intro: Let the forest spirit guide you through 12 little questions to find out which forest animal you are. Your animal becomes how you appear on the island.
forest.spirit_hello: I'm the forest spirit! Let's take a walk down the path and answer 12 little questions along the way. Don't overthink it: just pick the one that feels most like you.
forest.pick_hint: Pick the one most like you
forest.incomplete: A few questions are still unanswered. Fill them in to see your result.
forest.tips_title_me: Tips for getting along with you
forest.avatar_note: This little animal is now your avatar on the island.
forest.met: You've met in the First Meet Forest! This moment is now in the Memory Cottage.

reveal.hint_1: Someone seems to be hiding behind the bush… tap to peek?
reveal.hint_2: Rustle, rustle… something moved! Tap again!

guess.title: Which animal will {name} be?
guess.intro: Once {name} finishes the quiz, the First Meet Forest reveals whether you guessed right, and the moment goes into the Memory Cottage. You can change your guess until then.
guess.saved: Guess saved! It'll be revealed when {name} finishes.
guess.invalid: You can't guess right now. Try another animal.
guess.pending_note: You guessed {name} is the {animal}. It'll be revealed when they finish.
guess.invite: You're done! Which animal do you think {name} will be?
guess.guessed_me: {name} has guessed which animal you are. Finish the quiz to reveal it!
guess.revealed_flash: {name} guessed which animal you'd be. Visit the forest to see if they were right!
guess.reveal_right: {guesser} guessed {target} would be the {guess}, and got it right!
guess.reveal_wrong: {guesser} guessed {target} would be the {guess}, but it's the {actual}.

memories.title: Memory Cottage
memories.subtitle: All the days you've shared, kept safe here.
memories.note_placeholder: e.g. We watched the sunset from the balcony today
memories.added: Your memory is now in the cottage.
memories.empty_text: Finish a date quest, make up after a quarrel, meet in the First Meet Forest, or write down a little moment, and your memories will appear here.

title_section.forest: We met in the First Meet Forest

memories.room_title: Three things in the cottage you can tap
memories.photo_wall_empty: No memories with photos yet. Add a photo when you finish a quest or add a memory.

settings.title: Mailbox
settings.nickname_hint: Your nicknames must be different (you pick yours when logging in).
settings.key_unset: Not set: Whispers need a key to work.
settings.key_delete_confirm: Delete the key? Gentle delivery in Whispers will pause until a new key is added.
settings.key_saved: The new key passed the test and has been saved.
settings.key_ok: Connection works. The whisper magic is ready.
settings.key_none: No key has been set yet.
settings.key_hint: The key is stored only on your own island instance. Only its last 4 characters are ever shown.
settings.privacy_1: Everything on the island is stored only on your own island instance.
settings.privacy_2: Only Whispers sends the line you want reworded to DeepSeek. No other feature uses AI.
settings.privacy_3: Usland is not a counselling service. If you or your partner are in danger, call 000 or Lifeline on 13 11 14.
settings.motion_hint: When on, walking, reveal and confetti animations stop playing; everything still works. Applies to this device only, and turns on automatically if your system asks for reduced motion.
settings.reset_intro: If {name} forgets their PIN, create a reset code here and tell them. It works for {minutes} minutes, only once; creating a new one cancels the old one.
settings.reset_code_hint: Shown only this once. Tell them in person or by message, then they can use it under “Forgot PIN?” on the login page.
settings.reset_needs_partner: You can reset your partner's PIN once they've joined.

mood.title: How are you feeling?
mood.intro: Only you can set this. Your partner will see it on the island and in Whispers. It goes back to “Calm” after 24 hours.
mood.saved: Mood updated. Your partner will see it.
mood.invalid: That mood doesn't exist. Please pick again.

partner_hint.wronged: {name} feels a little hurt. Go extra gently.
partner_hint.need_space: {name} needs a little space. No rush to reply.

mood.cleared: Mood cleared. You're back to Calm.
mood.tap_again: Tap your current mood again to clear it, too.

footer.privacy: Your data stays on your own island instance.

sound.title_off: Tap to turn on music and sounds
sound.title: Sound
sound.intro: Off by default. Music and ambience only load after you turn sound on; these settings are saved in this browser only.
sound.need_js: Sound needs JavaScript enabled in your browser.

forest_intro.title: Welcome to your island
forest_intro.text: Why not start with a stroll through First Meet Forest? Answer 12 little questions to meet your animal, and it will sit on the picnic blanket with you. No rush, go whenever you like.

pin.change_intro: Enter your current PIN, then choose a new one.
pin.changed: Your PIN has been changed. Log in with the new one.
pin.forgot_intro: Ask your partner to log in and open Mailbox → Reset your partner's PIN. They'll get an 8-character reset code (valid for 30 minutes). Enter it below and choose a new PIN.
pin.forgot_solo: You're the only islander right now, so nobody can create a reset code for you. Ask whoever runs this island to run this in the project folder on the server:
pin.reset_done: Your new PIN is set. You can log in now.

character.title: Start a new character
character.intro: Pick a nickname and start your character over: the animal you found in the First-Meet Forest and your mood will be cleared, and you'll be back to the default look. You can take the forest quiz again afterwards. Your memories, messages and dates are all kept.
character.confirm: I understand my animal and mood will be cleared
character.done: Your new character is ready! Visit the First-Meet Forest to find your animal.

game.title: Bench Gomoku
game.intro: Sit on the island bench and play gomoku together: the first to get five in a row — across, down or diagonally — wins.
game.rules: Whoever starts a new game plays black and goes first; five in a row in any direction wins. You each play on your own phone or computer — the board updates when your partner moves.
game.no_game: No game yet — tap “New game” below.
game.turn_me: Your turn — tap a point to place a stone
game.result_draw: The board is full — it's a draw!
game.resign_confirm: Resign this game? Your partner will win it.

errors.out_of_range: That point isn't on the board
errors.finished: This game is over — start a new one
errors.no_game: No game yet — start a new one
errors.no_partner: You can play once your partner joins the island
errors.still_playing: This game isn't finished — resign first to start a new one
errors.too_fast: Easy there — wait a moment before throwing again

game.settle_win_text: You got five in a row first — {name} tips their hat!
game.settle_lose_text: {name} got five in a row first. Win the next one back!
game.settle_draw_text: The board is full and nobody won

demo.banner: This is a public demo island shared by every visitor. It resets to its starting state every {hours} hours, so please don't write real personal details.
demo.blocked: The demo island is shared by everyone, so this is turned off in the demo.
demo.login_intro: Pick a character to step straight onto the demo island, no PIN needed. Want to try it as a couple? Open two browser windows (or a private window) and enter as Wilson in one and Yvette in the other.
demo.login_hint: Every visitor shares these two characters, and the island resets every {hours} hours. Both PINs are {pin}.
demo.settings_text: This is a public demo island shared by every visitor. To keep it fair, you can't change the island name, nicknames, PINs or API key here, or upload photos. The island resets to its starting state every {hours} hours.
demo.reset_confirm: Reset the demo island to its starting state? Everyone's new messages, memories and games will be cleared, and everyone will need to pick a character again.
demo.reset_done: The demo island is back to its starting state. Pick a character to step back in.
demo.whisper_status: Demo: gentle delivery uses sample rewrites, not real AI
demo.no_photos: The demo island is shared, so photo uploads are off. Just write a line.
